title: Per-file Engine-Rules Schema
description: Schema for plugin/data/masters-corpus/<master>/<work>/derived/engine-rules.json files. Derived from firing-semantics spec v0.2 (plugin/docs/engine-rules-firing-spec.md). Per-file gate at PR time; complements the bundle-time validation in scripts/build_engine_rules_bundle.py. Ticket: #575.

schema_version.description: Spec schema version. v0.2 is current; v0.1 still accepted because every v0.1 rule fires identically under v0.2 per spec.

master_id.description: Master slug, must match a master.id in masters.json.

work_id.description: Work slug, must match a works[].id under the corresponding master.

rule_id.description: Unique identifier within this file; convention: <master-or-author>-<short-slug>.

when.description: Conjunctive (AND) predicate per spec §1. Each value is literal, array (OR), or the string 'any'.

then.description: Action map; passthrough in v0.1+v0.2 per spec §5. Downstream consumers realize concretely.

preference.description: Signed Likert int per spec §4. v0.1/v0.2 ratified after corpus migration #555.

oneOf.description: Pre-migration freeform prose; tolerated through transition window.
Pre-migration null tolerated; coerces to 0 (neutral) at firing time.

polarity.description: Derived from preference sign; optional in stored rules (engine computes if absent).

quality_binding.description: Hard prefilter per spec §2. Canonical chord-quality tokens (family parents + specific qualities). Non-canonical values should move to applicability_reasons per spec §2.4 / #555 migration; tolerated here for legacy entries.

applicability_reasons.description: Authorial annotations on WHY the rule applies (e.g. voice_leading, clarity, playability). Distinct from quality_binding which gates WHEN.

falsifier.description: Prose-only in v0.1/v0.2 per spec §7. Surface in review UI; engine does not machine-evaluate.

anchor.description: Verbatim short quote from source supporting the rule.

source_page.description: Page number in the source PDF; null for sources without paginable page references.
